text.tspan: Kaf partnered with Educate Me Foundation, AhlMasr Foundation, and Shagarha to deliver a hands-on environmental
awareness day for students, parents, volunteers, and burn survivors. The programme focused on planting activities,
recycling workshops, and practical sustainability learning, empowering children to understand how small daily
actions can protect the planet. This initiative reflects our commitment to building environmental awareness within
underserved communities, integrating education with inclusion, and inspiring long-term behavioral change.
FROM CLARITY TO IMPACT
Our Vision of a Responsible Future
Throughout this report, we have demonstrated how clarity of purpose translates into disciplined action. By setting
transparent goals, aligning capital with measurable outcomes, and embedding ESG principles across our platforms,
EFG Holding ensures that sustainability is not aspirational, but operational. Our ESG strategy reflects a holistic and
integrated approach to sustainable value creation, anchored in strong environmental stewardship, meaningful social
investment, and robust governance practices. Across its operations, the Firm continues to align financial performance
with environmental responsibility by advancing green financing solutions and actively managing its environmental
footprint through digitalization, efficiency measures, and emissions tracking.
At the same time, EFG Holding reinforces its commitment to inclusive growth by expanding access to finance,
investing in healthcare and education, and supporting community development through targeted initiatives. These
efforts demonstrate the Firm’s role not only as a financial institution, but as a driver of broader socio-economic
progress.
Underpinning these pillars is a strong governance framework that promotes ethical conduct, transparency, and
accountability, while embedding ESG considerations across business lines and functions. The integration of
advanced technologies further enhances oversight, risk management, and decision-making capabilities. Together,
these efforts position EFG Holding to navigate evolving market expectations, contribute to sustainable development,
and deliver long-term value to its stakeholders.
As we move forward, clarity will remain our guiding principle. Clear priorities, transparent reporting, and measurable
performance will continue to shape our strategy and strengthen stakeholder trust. In doing so, EFG Holding reaffirms
that sustainable growth is built on openness, responsibility, and the consistent delivery of real, demonstrable
progress.
Bank NXT has also strengthened its commitment to combating poverty and hunger by supporting the most
vulnerable families in partnership with respected non-profit organizations, including the Al Orman Association, the
West Cairo Department of the Ministry of Social Solidarity, and the Tahya Misr Fund. Through these collaborations,
food boxes were distributed to families in need across Cairo, Beni Suef, and Upper Egypt, along with school bags
for underprivileged children.
In parallel, Tanmeyah continued its stakeholder engagement initiatives, including sponsorship of a Ramadan Suhoor
event organized by Forset Hayah in collaboration with Redcon Properties, reinforcing its corporate citizenship and
community engagement commitments. From a broader social development perspective, Tanmeyah supported
through its One Classroom Programme, funding full elementary education for three schools
serving more than 100 students over a six-year period, reflecting Tanmeyah’s long-term commitment to sustainable
community impact and inclusive development.
